fieldValues.policy_explanation: The item's body carries a "## Technical plan" section with content: a plan written as one, on purpose. Detailed steps without the heading earn Medium, not this grade, and neither does the owner directing the work: agents run as the owner's actor and write issues in that shape too, so only the heading is taken as a written plan (clerk#157 review, B1 and B3).
